interpretation_limits: Pre-change production source was snapshotted before edits; both phases use the same fixture paths and measurement logic. Harness diagnostic-only differences are recorded separately.
Necessary compiler gates overlapped the baseline environment; raw CPU and latency vary with background workload and are not CPU speedup evidence.
The app runs at a fixed harness cadence rather than the native desktop event loop.
No native GUI or WSL helper CPU is measured; no Windows-to-WSL bridge is involved.
Edited text was observed in generated egui text shapes, not at compositor presentation.
harness_difference: After: fail fast when Git log cannot be read; before logs were present and verified nonzero. Successful-log counting is unchanged. rustfmt also wrapped a progress-output line.
p95_method: Nearest rank: sorted samples[ceil(0.95 * n) - 1]; n=30 in each phase

native_functional_smoke.build: Fresh debug binaries from settled production source; isolated IPC runtimes; installed applications preserved
